human.problem: Most of the passage is written as "we," and 1:1 names Paul, Silas and Timothy as the senders. The cards turn nearly every "we" into Paul alone, for example "Paul can't bear it any longer, so he's willing to be left on his own in Athens" (3:1), "Paul sends him off" (3:2) and "he can go on living" (3:8). Only 2:18 and 3:5 use "I." Card 1 also says "Paul... is writing" without the co-senders.
human.question: When a letter speaks as "we" and has co-senders, should Papa Dorin keep it as "we" or "Paul and his companions," or is it fine to retell it as Paul alone?
